replay.scratch_requirement: Use an executable disk-backed target-c985 scratch directory; /tmp is tmpfs and /tmp/persistent is noexec.
replay.command_template: TMPDIR=<disk-backed-target-c985-scratch> nix shell nixpkgs#cargo-mutants --command cargo mutants --profile campaign --all-features --baseline skip --copy-target false -j 2 -F 'logical_is_nonzero|wide_prefix_initial_bound' -C=--lib -C=css_distance::tests -o <output-dir>

assurance_boundary: The matrix oracle independently recomputes every logical observation for all supports; a controlled compiled table separately forces multiword xor cancellation and index-stride coverage. The prefix table exhausts sharded, unsharded, and saturation cases. These tests protect implementation semantics but do not prove the external CSS model or the shard-cover theorem.
